system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the jmxterm codebase. jmxterm is a command-line JMX client (alternative to jconsole) that lets users access a Java MBean server from a console. The codebase handles CLI option parsing, command execution with chained commands (e.g. open && beans), session and JMX connection lifecycle, URL resolution (host:port, PID, full JMX URL), MBean operations (get, set, run, beans, domain), notification subscription, file/stream I/O for script mode, JDK-specific process attachment (JDK 5/6/9) for local PID connect, and configuration loading from properties. Your goal is to identify bugs, correctness issues, boundary condition errors, logic errors, off-by-one mistakes, missing validation checks, resource leaks, and any other issues that could affect reliability or correctness. Focus on: ValueFormat quoted string handling, SyntaxUtils empty string vs null, OpenCommand getConnectorId null, session connection checks (getConnection vs isConnected), null guards before ObjectName, message typos, comment truncation split limit, tab-completion suggestArgument condition. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md

rubric.criterion: Identifies that in BeansCommand.getBeans() (cmd/BeansCommand.java) the code calls session.getConnection() without first checking session.isConnected(), so when the session is not connected it throws IllegalStateException instead of a user-friendly message.

Identifies that in GetCommand.displayAttributes() (cmd/GetCommand.java) the code calls new ObjectName(beanName) after BeanCommand.getBeanName() without guarding against null beanName, which can throw when bean resolves to null (e.g. isNull(bean)).

Identifies that in WatchCommand.execute() (cmd/WatchCommand.java) the IllegalArgumentException message when --report is used without --stopafter contains the typos "sepcified" and "specificed" instead of "specified".

Identifies that in CommandCenter.doExecute(String) (cc/CommandCenter.java) when truncating at the comment character (#) the code uses command.split(ESCAPE_CHAR_REGEX)[0] without a limit parameter; it should use split(ESCAPE_CHAR_REGEX, 2)[0] so that only the first unescaped # splits the line.

Identifies that in Command.suggestArgument(String partialArg) (Command.java) the condition is inverted: the code returns null when partialArg != null and only calls doSuggestArgument() when partialArg == null, so tab-completion suggestions are never shown when the user has typed a partial argument.

Identifies that in SyntaxUtils.parse() (SyntaxUtils.java) the isEmpty(expression) check was removed for non-String types, so empty string is passed to ConvertUtils.convert. Callers may expect null for empty expression; semantics for empty vs null can differ for MBean attributes/parameters. The fix is to return null when StringUtils.isEmpty(expression) for non-String types.

Identifies that in ValueFormat.parseValue() (utils/ValueFormat.java) single quotes are stripped the same as double quotes (wrong semantics). Values like 'x' are treated as quoted and stripped to x; only double quotes should denote quoted strings. The fix is to remove the single-quote stripping branch.

Identifies that in OpenCommand.execute() (cmd/OpenCommand.java) when url is null the code uses con.getConnectorId() and con.getUrl() in String.format without null-check. JMXConnector.getConnectionId() can return null in some implementations/states; using it in format yields literal "null" in output or can cause NPE in formatting. The fix is to null-check the result of getConnectorId() (and optionally getUrl()) before passing to format.
